title: GANTouch
summary: Code for the paper 'GANTouch: An Attack-Resilient Framework for Touch-based Continuous Authentication System', which builds a GAN-assisted continuous authentication system (G-TCAS) and evaluates its resilience to adversarial attacks compared to vanilla systems. featureExtractionAndUtilities.ipynb installs and imports the standalone ctgan package, fitting a CTGANSynthesizer to generate synthetic touch-behavior samples used in the adversarial attack pipeline.
